statements.t: Although we can provide no assurances, we believe that our cash flows from operations, combined with our current cash levels and our senior secured revolving credit facility with available borrowing capacity of $74.5 million as of September 30, 2026, and access to capital markets as necessary, will be adequate to fund debt service requirements and provide cash, as required, to support our ongoing operations,…

As of September 30, 2026, the total projected principal and interest payments on our borrowings are $327.0 million, primarily related to the Senior Notes, of which $24.8 million of interest is expected to be paid in the next 12 months.
Under this lease agreement, we will pay an annual base rent of $0.9 million, subject to an annual rent increase of 2.0% .

statements.t: The Company now expects low-double-digit revenue growth and Free Cash Flow of $50 million to $55 million, up from prior guidance of high-single-digit to low-double-digit revenue growth and $45 million to $50 million of Free Cash Flow.
The Company also expects its year-end Net Leverage Ratio towards the low-end of the 2.5x and 3.0x range.

The Company expects Integrated Paytech revenue growth to more than double in the fourth quarter compared with the third quarter, driven by continued momentum in Card@Once, the contribution from TRISM instant issuance and a more favorable year-over-year comparison.
